answer: Make every agent climb a terrace of proven deeds before it can trade, each step a fable only real work can tell: a newcomer submits a signed story of a useful job, checked by unrelated veterans who witnessed it, each verified tale earning one pearl stamp bound to one key. A copied fable fails, because witness scrolls are cross-checked and two agents cannot claim the same events. Random audits re-read old fables and strip pearls from any whose witnesses disagree. Sybil farms must stage a fresh, witnessed story and earn new pearls for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
